Noticed unlit drifting debris in shipping lane near 06-59.51N 058-03.07W; likely pallet or container remnant. Hard to see in chop—advise caution and lookout tonight there.
Possible wreck just awash near 33-20.93N 095-53.28W, no mark seen. Keep clear.
Observed partially submerged wreck in the shipping lane near 33-20.20N 079-26.50W; only a broken mast and debris visible, low freeboard, no buoy. Recommend wide berth and alerting traffic.
Possible hazard observed near 35-09.68N 096-23.94W; something in the water, hard to ID. Proceeding with caution.

While transiting the main shipping lane off the approaches, we observed a large unlit object drifting near 14-21.01N 041-25.33W. Appears like a partially submerged container or timber bundle, no AIS target, moving west with current, pose collision risk to deep-draft traffic at night; advise caution and report if sighted. Sea calm but visibility moderate in light rain.
Sighted rocket-like object descending/impacting near 39-49.73N 092-49.64W. Flash and debris, keep clear.
Observed unlit floating debris in shipping lane near 65-04.98N 086-43.57W around 2100 UTC, difficult to see, recommend caution and reduced speed.
Generic hazard noted near 41-09.46N 095-29.97W; something adrift in channel, hard to make out. Keep sharp watch passing through.

Noticed what looks like a partially submerged wreck in the main shipping lane at 18-54.23N 087-30.68W, with broken superstructure just awash and a rusted mast sticking up about 2 m. No AIS or markings, only a small swirl and oil sheen on the ebb. Recommend wide berth and caution for deep-draft traffic.
Wreck showing debris at 39-30.55N 095-32.89W, just awash. Give it room.

Spotted a partly submerged derelict wooden boat adrift in the traffic lane near 05-14.71N 052-42.12W. Only the stern and mast were showing about 1 m above water; no lights or markings. Recommend wide berth especially at night due to poor visibility. Weak tide setting it across lane south.
Debris/unknown hazard near 33-34.71N 096-26.00W. Keep sharp lookout, bit of it just awash.
In shipping lane near 19-57.95S 008-52.60E, spotted uncharted floating debris field; several large logs across track, reduced speed and advised nearby traffic via.
Old wreck showing just below surface at 40-27.28N 093-40.17W, unlit. Narrow clearance, steer well clear.

Spotted a large rocket stage adrift in the eastbound shipping lane near 29-30.46N 083-16.60W, looks intact but partially submerged and drifting west with the tide. No markers or low lights seen; recommend vessels keep clear and report to authorities as debris could be moving with current and posing collision risk at night tonight.
Wreck showing just below surface at 43-27.71N 098-41.62W. Seen on low tide, no mark.
Derelict skiff partially submerged in westbound traffic lane at 22-12.95N 091-25.91W; only bow showing. Passed within 0.5 nm during night passage, no lights. Recommend caution for vessels transiting.
Rocket launch splashdown debris drifting near 41-20.39N 099-13.87W, bits and smoke, keep clear. Drifting east, no warning on VHF.

Spotted a drifting rocket booster casing in main shipping lane near 07-29.15N 056-10.41W this afternoon, about 6 m long, partly awash with fuel smell. Keeping clear; it was rolling in swell and could foul a prop or leak. Suggest wide berth, no markings seen, just scorched metal surface.
Derelict hull drifting near 39-17.88N 098-32.95W. Low in water, unlit, just off our track.

Observed derelict fishing skiff adrift in main shipping lane near 33-30.62N 078-38.68W at 0415 UTC, no lights, partially flooded, low in water, paint weathered, no name or registration visible, debris around. Vessel was drifting south about 1 knot, uncrewed, and could be hard to spot in chop; recommend wide berth and alert traffic.
Possible hazard sighted near 39-22.39N 095-14.68W. Unclear object drifting, keep sharp lookout.

Observed an active rocket launch hazard in the main shipping lane near 06-54.34N 058-08.79W; bright plume and debris trail crossing the track, radio silence on local traffic. Recommend wide berth and slow to minimum until area declared clear. Small craft turning back, and a strong smell of burning fuel on deck at times.
Wreck at 40-03.21N 098-20.88W, just awash. No marks, watch your draft.

Spotted an unlit object low in the water at 25-37.41N 080-18.24W in the eastbound lane, looks like a half-submerged crate or container panel drifting with current; only visible in swell and radar return weak. We altered 15 degrees to pass clear; recommend extra lookout and reduced speed as traffic is heavy and this could be hard to spot in low light this evening.
Wreck showing just under surface at 40-38.07N 096-14.80W. No marker, watch your draft.

Observed unlit object drifting in main shipping lane near 28-10.60N 073-22.05W around 2300 local, from bridge wing sighting, possibly a semi-submerged container; no AIS target and only sporadic radar return. Had to alter 20 degrees to starboard to clear by half mile; heavy traffic in area, recommend caution and close watch until it drifts or is marked.
Derelict wooden skiff, low in water at 43-39.39N 094-17.98W. Hard to see until close.

Transiting the inbound lane near 28-25.47N 080-17.79W at 0430Z, we encountered a large unlit floating container (grey, partially submerged) drifting south across the traffic separation scheme, about 200 m off our starboard bow. Logged and reported to VTS, but any northbound traffic should keep sharp lookout as it was moving with the current at around 1-2 knots.
Derelict hull drifting near 42-52.32N 094-57.74W. Low in water, no lights.

Noticed a wreck protruding just awash at 10-20.71N 075-59.14W in the northbound lane, looks like a small steel hull with debris and oil sheen. We passed close aboard at low tide; recommend giving it wide berth and marking for traffic.
Rocket debris floating and smoke seen near 39-01.88N 094-04.97W. Keeping clear.
Saw a rocket launch and falling debris near shipping lane at 19-45.25N 086-55.96W; loud detonation, caution advised to nearby traffic.
Rocket sighted low over water near 37-26.26N 093-04.77W, unknown origin. Avoid area.
Observed derelict fishing skiff adrift in main shipping lane at 21-59.12N 097-29.93W, low in water and unlit; passed 0.5 nm off, poses collision risk for night traffic and deep-draft vessels.
Wreck sighted near 35-03.05N 095-16.17W. Unmarked, breaks at low tide.

At 25-37.15N 080-23.54W in the main shipping lane, saw what looked like a small rocket or missile stage bobbing low in the water, metal cylinder with fins, possible fuel residue. We gave it a wide berth and heard no radio warnings. Recommend caution for vessels transiting this track until confirmed cleared.
Generic hazard sighted near 37-01.69N 096-11.24W, drifting debris in traffic lane. Marked and avoided.
In main shipping lane near 28-36.74N 080-16.65W, observed unlit floating debris about 3m long, likely timber, drifting west with current; keep sharp watch.
Derelict hull adrift near 44-09.69N 097-01.00W, low in water, hard to see. Keep clear.
Observed rocket debris floating in shipping lane near 28-45.54N 073-28.47W; metallic cylinder with fins, drifting north. Recommend wide berth, possible fuel residue, reported to VTS.
Rocket debris sighted drifting near 44-55.16N 095-38.31W. Keep clear, unknown source.

Spotted a partially submerged pallet and debris field in the eastbound lane at 28-35.35N 080-38.82W, about 0.5 nm long, with small timbers and plastic drums. No AIS targets nearby, visibility good, but the debris is hard to see until close; recommend caution and reduced speed for following traffic, looks like it may have come from a lost load, drifting SW with current slowly.
Generic hazard noted near 39-14.50N 095-22.51W. Unclear what it is, advise caution.

Sighted a wreck in the shipping lane near 28-19.32N 075-17.11W during night transit; structure awash with occasional metallic glint, no lighting or buoyage observed. Depth sounder showed sudden shoaling to 9 m then back to 24 m. Recommend caution and altered track.
Derelict hull low in water near 37-56.15N 092-10.34W. No lights.
Spotted unlit drifting object in main shipping lane near 36-39.55N 076-03.67W, hard to see on radar; suggest caution and slow speed until clear.
Unlit obstruction seen near channel at 36-21.67N 099-59.84W, hard to pick up on radar. Marked by small wake only.

Noticed an unmarked wreck just off the main traffic lane at 18-27.99N 069-53.86W while outbound, with a small bit of structure showing at low swell and breakers on top. We passed within half a cable and saw no buoy or light; recommend giving it wide berth, especially at night or in reduced visibility.
Saw rocket launch activity near 38-32.17N 093-04.45W; bright plume and debris splashdown area, keep clear. May be ongoing.

Spotted a wreck marking low in the water on the edge of the shipping lane near 11-02.37N 078-54.36W; only a bit of steel and paint showing at half tide. No light or buoy, just a small slick and debris. Give it a wide berth, especially in swell.
Rocket seen near 44-42.20N 096-07.33W, low over water, unknown origin. Keep clear.
At 14-46.37N 060-53.89W in the eastbound lane, encountered unlit floating debris, likely pallet or small log, drifting mid‑channel with current. Advised vessels keep sharp lookout.
Wreck showing just under surface at 34-56.41N 093-27.68W, breaking in swell. Give it a wide berth.

Noted unlit floating debris, likely broken pallet and plastic sheeting, drifting across the shipping lane near 07-58.60N 056-43.13W at 2200 local. Passed within half a mile on starboard, swell pushing it west, could be a snag hazard for smaller craft and tugs.
Rocket launch debris spotted drifting near 36-21.46N 094-50.41W. Unclear source, keep sharp lookout.

Spotted a derelict fishing skiff adrift in the shipping lane at 25-33.14N 074-45.35W, low in the water with no lights or AIS, maybe 6–7 meters, dark hull and some netting trailing off the stern. No crew seen, just drifting across the track on the current, could be hard to pick up in chop, recommend caution and a wide berth.
Unlit debris or small craft dead in water near 38-09.73N 097-50.04W. Difficult to spot at night.
Observed unlit wreckage at 28-32.66N 080-24.39W in main shipping lane; low in water, just awash, recommend avoidance and alerting traffic tonight during northbound.
Rocket debris sighted near 39-51.02N 093-09.78W, pieces floating, caution. Not sure if active.

Observed floating object in shipping lane near 14-22.59N 073-18.74W, unlit and drifting slowly across traffic this evening. No AIS target, looks like container or debris; keep sharp lookout and reduce speed at night.
Hazard observed near 40-09.40N 092-45.52W. Unknown object just under surface, steer clear.

Noted a wreck showing just awash at 11-59.85N 068-38.18W in the southbound lane; only a bit of rusted superstructure and debris on the surface at low swell. No AIS return and no lit marker, several fishing skiffs working nearby, so recommend a wide berth and slow speed until properly buoyed.
Derelict wooden skiff adrift near 36-04.65N 093-17.16W, no lights, low in water. Passed close on starboard, keep clear.

Observed a rocket launch splashdown area active in the main shipping lane near 28-35.65N 080-25.12W; range safety broadcast on VHF 16 advised exclusion but no markings visible. Recommend wide berth and speed reduction as debris and falling hardware reported in vicinity for next 2 hours.
Derelict hull sighted at 35-27.48N 092-27.30W, low in water, no lights. Drifted slowly west.

Spotted a low-lying wreck/structure in the main shipping lane near 64-09.33N 087-59.40W, only a few feet awash, unlit at night and hard to pick up on radar. Recommend caution for deep-draft vessels; small debris and turbulence observed around it on flood tide.
Wreck reported near 39-20.13N 096-45.94W. Low in water, hard to spot.
Spotted derelict fishing boat low in water and unlit in shipping lane near 25-51.82N 092-53.71W at dusk; recommend slow speed and wide berth.
Rocket debris sighted near 37-52.52N 093-40.32W drifting, possible unexploded. Advise keep clear.

Sighted a derelict 6–7 m white fishing skiff low in the water and adrift in the traffic lane at 31-59.14N 064-30.73W, no lights or AIS, no crew visible. Passed at 0.3 NM; looks abandoned and presents a collision risk to northbound ships, recommend caution and broadcast to nearby traffic.
Derelict small craft adrift near 43-03.09N 098-10.84W, low in water, no lights.

Spotted a rocket debris splash and smoke plume drifting across the shipping lane at 36-44.13N 076-00.36W around 0630Z. We altered course to starboard; advise caution and expect possible falling debris in vicinity.
Saw rocket launch debris falling near 35-43.71N 096-04.54W, loud blast, smoke. Steer clear.
Spotted a derelict wooden skiff adrift in the shipping lane at 18-29.01N 081-28.56W, low in the water, no markings or lights.
